headline: Pal condensation explained
title: Pal Condensation Explained | Star Up Your Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Condensing makes a Pal stronger in Palworld one point zero. Build the Pal Essence Condenser, pick the Pal you want to upgrade, and feed it duplicates of the same species. Reaching four stars now takes roughly forty eight copies, much cheaper than before. Each star boosts its stats, and the top rank raises its work suitabilities. The fodder is consumed forever, so check the preview before you confirm. Which Pal are you condensing? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 condensation: use the Pal Essence Condenser, feed same-species duplicates, and reach four stars for roughly 48 copies.
